### R8: Regression contract for legacyAuthFlow() parity (IRON RULE)
Finding: T1, P1 CRITICAL, confidence 9/10, PLAN.md:23-25 "That coverage does not exercise legacyAuthFlow() or assert compatibility with its prior behavior" + PLAN.md:36-37 "no regression test for the prior behavior is planned"; reviewer: Claude
Plan baseline: no regression coverage. D3 = A makes legacyAuthFlow() the fallback and requires "parity proven" before deletion, but HOW parity is proven was unapproved.
Runtime evidence: unknown — legacyAuthFlow() not in repo; its callers and behavior must be enumerated during implementation.
State: approved
Comparison grid:

| Choice | Current | A | B | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R8 parity proof | none | characterization suite + shadow compare: (1) record legacyAuthFlow() input→outcome fixtures for every allow, deny and error class per tenant type; run both paths against them in CI; (2) with flag in "shadow" mode, run both paths in prod, serve legacy result, log any mismatch with tenant id + reason kind | characterization suite only (CI) | shadow compare only (prod) |
| Behavior to preserve | unstated | allow/deny outcome, error class → response mapping, cache entries written (key + TTL), invalidation on logout/revocation/suspension | same | same, observed at runtime only |
| Intentional differences | unstated | fail-closed on formerly swallowed errors (D7): listed explicitly as expected mismatches | same | same |
| Deletion gate for legacy | unstated | 0 unexpected mismatches over an agreed window (proposal: 7 days, ≥1 canary tenant per tenant type) | green CI suite | 0 mismatches over the window |
| R1/R7 | approved | fixed | fixed | fixed |

Question D8:
D8 — How do we prove the new path matches legacyAuthFlow() before deleting it: characterization tests plus shadow comparison, tests only, or shadow only?
Header: Regression
Options:
A) Characterization suite + shadow-mode comparison (recommended)
B) Characterization suite only
C) Shadow-mode comparison only
Actual answer: A — Characterization suite + shadow-mode comparison (user answer to D8)
Accepted scope: (1) `legacyAuthFlow.characterization.test` — fixture table of inputs → {outcome, error kind, cache writes} recorded from legacyAuthFlow(), run against both legacyAuthFlow() and AuthBroker.validateAndDispatch() in CI; covers every allow, deny and each formerly swallowed error class, per tenant type. (2) Flag gains a third state `SHADOW`: run both paths, serve legacy, emit `auth.parity.mismatch{tenant, kind}` on disagreement. (3) Expected-mismatch allowlist: D7 fail-closed cases. (4) Legacy deletion gate: 0 unexpected mismatches over 7 days with ≥1 canary tenant per tenant type. Behavior preserved: allow/deny outcome, error class → response mapping, cache entries written (key + TTL), invalidation on logout/revocation/suspension.
History: none
